stateTransition: PLANNED -> IMPLEMENTING -> LOCALLY_VERIFIED -> OWNER_ONLY_DEPLOYED -> LIVE_VERIFIED -> OWNER_ONLY_VERSION_3_LIVE_VERIFIED
scope: Fictional device-local hotel booking demo; no real booking, payment, email, external cancellation, or personal information.

liveDeployment.evidence: Sites version 3 and deployment readback identify commit 5f603be2846735256ab1ef87fdb339af8f8d9676 as the exact deployed source. The owner-only live run discovered exactly four safe tools, required the separate human confirmation button, converged two attempts to one booking and one effect start with confirmation FKR-C5E1BBD490, restored that result after reload, kept cancellation preview read-only, displayed a valid four-event UUIDv7 and SHA-256 chain, and produced zero browser console entries.

checks.name: Language-neutral UUIDv5 identity
checks.evidence: Node test proves English and Japanese presentation inputs derive the same fixed-namespace UUIDv5.

checks.name: Two attempts remain one booking
checks.evidence: Concurrency tests directly count one physical row in the IndexedDB bookings store. At the owner-only production URL, the in-app browser reported attempts=2, bookings=1, effectStartCount=1, and the same confirmation number after asynchronous reload restoration completed.

checks.name: Exactly four non-destructive WebMCP tools
checks.evidence: At https://kyoto-booking-retry-proof.anionix.chatgpt.site, the in-app browser discovered and called exactly check_existing_hotel_booking, prepare_hotel_booking, get_hotel_booking_status, and preview_hotel_cancellation. Preparation changed the matching visible request to PREPARED and enabled the separate human confirmation button; no confirmation, payment, or cancellation tool was present.

checks.name: Production build restores offline after first visit
checks.evidence: At http://127.0.0.1:4184, a forced network-offline reload restored RETRY_RECOGNIZED, the non-default 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-07 stay, four adults, two rooms, Japanese presentation, the same confirmation, attempts=2, bookings=1, and effects=1.

checks.name: Expired preparation becomes one durable event
checks.evidence: The 120-second boundary is derived as EXPIRED on a read. Page timer, restoration, or repeated preparation then persists PREPARED -> EXPIRED exactly once without a booking row or effect start.

checks.name: Current price rule is rechecked before commit
checks.evidence: A regression test changes both the stored quote and its stored approval digest to a 13,000-yen rule. Human confirmation rejects it against the current 12,000-yen calculation before a booking row or effect start exists.

checks.name: Responsive widths and control target sizes
checks.evidence: Browser checks at 320, 375, 390, and 768 CSS pixels found no horizontal overflow; all tested form controls were at least 44 by 44 CSS pixels.

checks.name: Keyboard focus traversal
checks.evidence: The browser-control backend focused native form elements but did not advance focus when sending Tab. Source uses native links, labels, inputs, selects, buttons, details, headings, and a skip link; an independent physical-keyboard run is still required.

checks.name: Screen-reader announcement
checks.evidence: ARIA labels, alert, live regions, heading order, and native controls are present; no VoiceOver or other assistive-technology session was recorded.

checks.name: Google Chrome page and WebMCP runtime
checks.evidence: Chrome reached the owner-only production URL but displayed Sign in required, so live page execution was not measured. Earlier local Chrome testing restored a non-default Japanese stay with attempts=2, bookings=1, effects=1, but the native WebMCP runtime was not exposed; Chrome discovery and execution remain inconclusive.

checks.name: Visible local proof panel
checks.evidence: The live owner-only Sites version 3 displayed reservation UUIDv5 9494291c-89cb-555d-9ac0-5480707e1740, latest event UUIDv7 01a04b9f-a461-7974-9304-fbcc01f853f6, four events, chain head 18f47498163f..., and Valid after retry. The same panel also passed local 320 CSS-pixel wrapping without horizontal overflow.

checks.name: Bounded source-quality toolchain
checks.evidence: Pinned Oxlint 1.80.0 checks hotel JavaScript, Biome 2.5.11 checks the hotel HTML and CSS, and Oxfmt 0.65.0 checks the newly governed formatting surface. npm run quality:check completed without diagnostics; historical files outside the declared surface were not reformatted.

checks.name: ChatGPT Sites live execution
checks.evidence: The owner-only production URL verifies Sites version 3 from exact source commit 5f603be2846735256ab1ef87fdb339af8f8d9676. It loaded with zero console entries, exposed exactly four safe tools, enabled the separate human confirmation button only after preparation, preserved 2 attempts -> 1 booking -> 1 effect start -> confirmation FKR-C5E1BBD490, kept cancellation preview read-only, and restored the same state after reload.

designFidelity.concept: Warm white paper surface with deep indigo and restrained vermilion accents.
designFidelity.implementation: The browser view keeps the same three-color hierarchy without decorative imagery that competes with the content.

designFidelity.concept: Editorial serif question paired with compact sans-serif operational text.
designFidelity.implementation: The question and section headings use a system serif stack; state, labels, and evidence use a system sans-serif stack.

designFidelity.concept: Question and current state appear together before the detailed workflow.
designFidelity.implementation: Desktop uses a two-column opening; mobile stacks the same title and state before the booking form starts.

designFidelity.concept: Square evidence cards with fine borders and quiet shadows.
designFidelity.implementation: Status, booking, retry, tool, and service evidence use square bordered cards and one restrained shadow token.

designFidelity.concept: A compact booking path remains readable on a phone.
designFidelity.implementation: At 320 through 390 pixels the fields and proof cards stack without horizontal overflow and keep 44-pixel controls.

designFidelity.concept: The generated concept pictured a commit_booking agent tool.
designFidelity.implementation: That tool was intentionally removed: only the visible human button imports the commit function, while WebMCP exposes four non-payment, non-cancellation functions.
